I don't know if I have to import or export any private keys. I just pasted the wallet address on the pool, and that's it. How long do I have to wait to see the amount in my wallet? Is there a solid explanation how it works in general? Or maybe pools have their own politics.

edit: I don't want to confuse people. I assumed that the pool has its own wallet, so thus I wrote from wallet to wallet. Correct me if I am wrong. It should be from pool (wallet's pool) to personal wallet.
How long does it take to transfer bits from one wallet to another?

Depends on how many confirmations each wallet requires to confirm payment.

It also depends on whether or not you pay the small transaction fee that comes with each transfer.

If your wallet is online then that usually isn't a problem.

I would say at most 40 minutes.

I say mine usually take between 10 and 20 minutes. That's a good average.

Also if you haven't heard already mining is not worth it anymore.

The cost of electricity you will use is more than what you can make in bitcoins from mining.

If you need to access bitcoins then I would try circle.com or coinbase.com to buy them.

I would personally not recommend coinbase. They ask you to give your bank account username and password. They donot trust you, but expect you to trust them with access you your financial accounts.

Giving anyone access to your accounts is a good way to get robbed. And it amazes me that within the bitcoin community, one with great awareness and concern for security a company that uses such a practice continues to exist.
I'm not a fan of coinbase either actually. But there aren't a lot of ways to buy bitcoins at face value without giving some personal information from what I've gathered.

Don't ever give anyone your private key, that's like giving away your credit card number.

You will see a transaction withing seconds of it being sent then it will be confirmed with each new block as a valid transaction (around every 10min). Pools usually have their own politics with regards to payout time and minimum payout threshold.
